title: Resolve financial control-account discrepancies
management_question: Which balances are reliable enough to manage the business from?
rationale: 4 independently assessed reconciliation control(s) failed. Residuals are control exceptions, not assumed losses: UWB_AR_TO_TB: 982806.0, UWB_AP_TO_TB: -279000.0, UWB_INVENTORY_TO_SUPPORT: 120000.0, UWB_DEBT_TO_SUPPORT: -125000.0.
next_step: Reconcile each failed control to source records, identify timing/classification differences and document resolution.
limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

supporting_evidence.evidence_summary: Investigate and resolve the evidenced integrity/reconciliation weakness, documenting ownership and resolution. No expected-loss value is invented and management retains the decision to fix, monitor or accept the risk.
